# @degreesign/cache

> 标签: compressed json, data persistence, degreesign, disk cache, disk-backed cache, file cache, filesystem cache, gzip cache, json cache, live cache, local cache, node cache, nodejs cache, read write files, server cache, sync file cache, typescript cache sdk, zero dependency cache

## 简介

Instant, dependency-free Node.js data read/write caching SDK — files, JSON, gzip-compressed JSON, and a disk-backed live cache with TypeScript types.
